tables.create_table:
CREATE TABLE `ChatMessage` (
  `content` TEXT,
  `created_at` DATETIME,
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `model` TEXT,
  `role` VARCHAR(64),
  `session` TEXT,
  `thinking` TEXT
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE `ChatSession` (
  `client_info` TEXT,
  `created_at` DATETIME,
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `owner` TEXT,
  `style` TEXT,
  `title` TEXT,
  `uuid` CHAR(36)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE `ChatStyle` (
  `creator` TEXT,
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `image_url` TEXT,
  `is_public` BOOLEAN,
  `name` TEXT,
  `popularity` BIGINT,
  `system_prompt` TEXT
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE `User` (
  `created_at` DATETIME,
  `email` TEXT,
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `locked` BOOLEAN,
  `password_hash` TEXT,
  `username` TEXT
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

queries.source: recent_messages = ChatMessage |> where(_.id between request.after_id and request.before_id)
